notes.title: The release of our very first game, Project HECK!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce the release of our very first game, Project HECK! Inspired by stress-relief toys, this game offers a simple and enjoyable typing experience designed to help you unwind and find a moment of relaxation amidst your busy life.

As this is our team's debut release, we highly value your feedback and would love to hear your thoughts. If you encounter any bugs or have any suggestions, please feel free to leave a comment in the discussion section. We are committed to improving the game and providing players with the best possible experience.

Thank you for your support! We hope you enjoy the game!

By CyberMonk Studio
